title: Colorway Editor Updates | Clo 2025.0 Features Deep Dive
description:
The new update to Colorways in CLO 2025.0 allows you to easily toggle the Colorway Editor with a keyboard shortcut and quickly edit the current colorway by clicking color chips in the Object Browser. You can also edit the fabric's side and back, along with trims, directly in the Colorway Editor. Check out other new features here: https://www.clo3d.com/en/clo/features

00:18 Object Browser Color Chips

markdown_content: ## Overview of Colorway Editor Updates in Clo 2025.0 This section introduces key updates to the Colorway Editor in Clo 2025.0, focusing on enhanced workflow efficiency through new shortcut keys and improved colorway management. It highlights how users can switch between colorways seamlessly and access the editor more quickly. --- ## Switching Between Colorways Without Opening the Editor In Clo 2025.0, users can now switch between different colorways directly from the simulation workspace without opening the full Colorway Editor. This is done by selecting color chips displayed in the interface, which automatically updates the garment to the chosen colorway. This feature streamlines the design review process by allowing quick visual comparisons of color options. --- ## Opening the Colorway Editor with a Shortcut The Colorway Editor can now be accessed more efficiently using the shortcut key **O**. The editor is located under the top toolbar menu path: **Production > Colorway**. This shortcut provides faster navigation for making detailed colorway adjustments, reducing the need to manually search through menus. --- ## Front and Back Colorway Management The Colorway Editor displays both front and back colorways for garments, allowing designers to manage colors and textures on each side independently. This dual-view setup supports detailed customization, such as applying different fabric colors or textures to the front and back panels. --- ## Working with Colorway Grids and Increases Within the editor, colorway grids correspond to different fabric sections and increases (pattern adjustments). Although some grids may not appear in the economic section, designers can use screenshots or imports from humbuck tools to facilitate editing and visualization of these grids. This functionality enables fine control over silhouettes and fabric details in ordered pieces. --- ## Editing and Applying Colors to Specific Sections Users can select individual sections within the colorway grids to apply or adjust colors. For example, a designer can: - Select a section and apply a darker hue. - Choose a brighter yellow for another section. - Switch between colorways to verify adjustments on both front and back fabrics. These edits are instantly reflected on the garment, allowing for rapid iteration of color schemes. --- ## Handling Multiple Textures and Trims The updated Colorway Editor supports different textures and trims for both front and back colorways. Designers can see and edit all trims, such as sliders and pullers, separately within the editor. Each trim section can be selected and altered independently, enhancing detailed customization of garment components. --- ## Summary The Clo 2025.0 Colorway Editor introduces streamlined workflows for colorway switching, shortcut access, and detailed front/back color and texture editing. Users benefit from the ability to quickly adjust fabrics and trims across multiple sections, improving the speed and precision of digital garment visualization.
